run(html, show=True, header='Intro', level=0): builds the parser, sets the state that the opening tags and the text would set, feeds the html and returns the state.
pinned_behavior: typical: h1, h2 and h3 add an entry to the table of contents with no indent, 4 spaces and 8 spaces, and clear the tags; the last closed tag is recorded.
edge: hidden content adds nothing; span, a, pre and other tags reset their own state; dd and ul decrease the indent level and update the tags.
invalid: a header closed while the indent level is not 0 fails the assert (AssertionError).
not_pinned_on_purpose: The other tags kept by the parser (nested_dl, simplelist, hprefix) are not touched by the snippet.
